mainEntity.name: How does GEO differ from traditional SEO for pool contractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO relies on manual content creation, keyword research, and optimization, which can be time-consuming and limit content volume. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) automates and scales these processes using AI, allowing for the rapid production of vast amounts of highly targeted and localized content. While both aim to improve search rankings, GEO's AI-driven approach enables quicker adaptation to algorithm changes and market trends, providing a more agile and comprehensive content strategy for pool contractors.
acceptedAnswer.description: GEO uses AI to automate and scale content creation and optimization, differing from traditional SEO's manual approach by offering faster adaptation and higher volume.
